extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or locate an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating or locating a Wikipedia article with a given title (what to do when an exact-match article does not exist). Covers account requirements, searching for alternatives, redirects, and deletion checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account / autoconfirmation requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles with the title
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Look for alternative titles or spellings if the exact name is not present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding incoming links can help locate coverage or identify whether a redirect is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider database update delays and use purge
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case-sensitive (except first character); check capitalizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider adding a redirect here to the correct title if capitalization or minor spelling differs.

rubrics_metrics.name: If a page was deleted, check the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See 'Why was the page I created deleted?' for reasons and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request new article when not autoconfirmed
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are not autoconfirmed, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are alternatives to directly creating an article when account status or protections prevent creation.
